rationale: The agent did not authenticate the user, did not verify or act only on the user’s specific order, and did not confirm any order-changing action before proceeding. It provided a conclusory statement that the exchange is in process without showing any tool calls or checks for availability/specs (coffee machine pressure preference 8/9/7 bar fallback) or identifying the cheapest i7+ laptop. It also failed to discuss potential price differences or confirm the preferred payment method (gift card first, then credit card). The response asserts changes without evidence from tools and skips required confirmations, violating the stated policy. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
